commands.name: lanes
commands.description: Open live lanes, or forward arguments to cdx

tools.name: land
tools.description: Commit green lanes, gate the merge result once unless a receipt already proves it, fast-forward the base, push, remove worktrees and branches, and close. Pass lanes for a batch; a red batch names the lane that broke it and lands the green prefix. A land a receipt proves runs inline; one that must run its gate detaches into a land-<lane> job and returns at once, and that job's exit event carries the land result.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask Gemini a synchronous read-only code question without creating a lane. Returns file and line evidence within 90 seconds.

tools.name: spawn
tools.description: Spawn a new cdx work lane. A work brief needs an outcome, owned files, acceptance, out-of-scope and a gate (gate or the repository's .cdx-gate); pass them as fields or as "## Outcome", "## Files", "## Acceptance", "## Out of scope" sections in brief. A supervisor also needs two or more children file sets. The brief is delivered whole through stdin; completion arrives as a [cdx] event.

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Repair a failed gate or P1/P2 review on the same diff. New scope needs a fresh lane seeded from the report.

tools.name: consult
tools.description: Start a read-only consultation lane to analyze code and answer a question.

tools.name: panel
tools.description: Ask Astra, Sol and Claude Fable the same read-only question. cdx merges the three answers by cited path into reports/panels/<name>/panel.md, keeps disagreement, and sends one completion line.

tools.name: review
tools.description: Start an independent code review lane. Two exclusive modes: intent reviews the working tree; uncommitted, base or commit chooses a Git diff target. Passing intent with a target flag is refused.

tools.name: events
tools.description: Return every owned event not yet delivered: the mod's buffer, then the feed.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send steering instructions or a message to a running lane.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Answer an open question asked by a lane.

tools.name: questions
tools.description: List open questions across all lanes or for a specific lane.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show the status of active and recent cdx lanes. brief returns one line per running or unclosed lane plus running jobs; the default is the detailed block per lane.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Read the final report written by a finished lane.

tools.name: tail
tools.description: Inspect the latest execution log lines for a running or finished lane.

tools.name: close
tools.description: Close a completed lane and archive its status.

tools.name: kill
tools.description: Terminate a running lane process immediately.

tools.name: gate
tools.description: Set or clear the verification gate command for a lane.

tools.name: gate-receipt
tools.description: Read content-bound acceptance proof for the latest work round.

tools.name: job
tools.description: Launch a detached background job command beside lanes.

tools.name: msg
tools.description: Send a notification message to a session or lane.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: Read incoming messages sent to this session.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Report Codex and Gemini quota rows, observed burn, projected forfeiture and exhaustion, holds, and GPT account picks. json includes evidence and ledger totals; totals adds ledger totals to text.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Diagnose plugin installation, engine accounts, and background workers.
